# Hyperobjects Spec

Last Updated: 2026-09-06

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

## What this is

The keystone of the MADFAM hyperobjects commons: the conformance bar for one
cartridge, as an installable Python package, with no platform checkout. Two
commons pin it BY SHA and consume it in CI — yantra4d (solid cartridges) and
fashion-cabinet (soft ones). A rule added here reaches their merge path on the
next repin.

This repo is PUBLIC and Apache-2.0. No secrets, no internal hostnames, no client
names, no runbook content. See the repo-boundary section of `AGENTS.md`.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions, and the only place that
  summarizes the check tiers, the parity line, the `verification` block and the
  `constraints[]` dialect in one page.
- `README.md` — the human document: every gate with the incident that motivated
  it. Authoritative on *why*.
- `llms-full.txt` — the module map and the durable contracts.

## Commands

    y4d-spec check ./cartridge [--render] [--parity] [--require-openscad]
    y4d-spec rules            # what gets checked, and where each rule came from
    y4d-spec render-env       # the render environment contract (packages, OpenSCAD, fonts)
    fc-spec  check <contract> <file>
    ho-bridge check --fc ./fashion-cabinet --y4d ./yantra4d

`y4d-spec rules` is generated from the code, so prefer running it over trusting
any prose summary — including this one.

## The three tiers, which are not interchangeable

FAIL (exit 1) is a conformance failure. `note` (exit 0) is true and not fatal.
`skip` (exit 0) is NOT VERIFIED — a target nothing judged. `geometry=NOT
verified` in the summary means the run had no `--render` and proved nothing
about meshes.

## Graph cartridges — the transpiler is VENDORED

A `.graph.json` mode is transpiled to CadQuery and judged on the CadQuery path, so
it clears the identical bar. `src/y4d_spec/graph/` is a BYTE-IDENTICAL copy of
yantra4d's `apps/api/services/engine/graph_engine.py` + its two schemas, pinned by
sha256 in `graph.lock.json`, enforced by `scripts/qa/check_graph_sync.py`, and
excluded from ruff. Never hand-edit it: change the platform and re-vendor
(`src/y4d_spec/graph/VENDORED.md`). Do not bump SPEC_PIN as part of a re-vendor.

Golden-twin rule: a mode declaring BOTH a script and a graph has the two compared
by `--parity` at the same bar as the cross-kernel comparison; the graph must agree
with its script before the script may be retired.

## Doctrine

New rules land as notes. A rule that fires on healthy cartridges is wrong;
nothing becomes a failure until its false-positive analysis against the whole
commons is written down. Test fixtures are real cartridges — a rule that flags
them is the rule's bug.

## Not here

Repo-wide checks (catalog drift, cross-cartridge slug uniqueness) stay in the
platforms. Cross-kernel parity used to and does NOT any more: it is a property
of one cartridge, so it runs here under `--render --parity`.
